outcome: 3D structure of the pulmonary arterial tree
cohort: Fetal rabbits (n = 6 with DH, n = 5 sham-operated controls) that had a left-sided diaphragmatic hernia surgically created at gestational day 23 and were delivered at gestational day 30.
finding: Surgically induced diaphragmatic hernia in fetal rabbits led to a significant reduction in pulmonary arterial cross-sectional area, primarily due to reduced arterial branching, which could contribute to pulmonary hypertension.
